title: 第494章 格里菲斯的警告第493章 亚历克格里菲斯
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 格里菲斯沉默了片刻，看着林鬼，开口了。
“既然你知道摩根与大贤者的关系，知道千塔对半魔的狩猎，那为何还会和摩根他们走在一起？”
“当初摩根带着半魔逃离，将半魔彻底推向千塔的对立面。”
“你帮助他们成为运输队的行为，对于千塔而言就是一种无法容忍的挑衅。”
“他们会视你为敌人。”
“为什么还要和半魔在一起，帮助他们成为运输队，抵抗千塔？”
为什么？
林鬼总不可能和格里菲斯说，他连联盟都打算动手，他还在意千塔？
他本人身上藏着的雷，可比摩根离谱太多了。
林鬼没有急着回答。
他端起面前的茶杯喝了一口，放下，然后开口，语气不急不慢。
“所以我带着他们来参加运输队的选拔会，成为烈阳。”
“千塔再怎么强大、再怎么蛮横，都不可能对烈阳运输队动手。”
“千塔是联盟的眼，运输公会是联盟的心脏。”
“而烈阳，是这颗心脏最重要的组成部分。”
他顿了一下。
“如果千塔失了智，在这种情况下还打算对摩根阁下动手——”
他沉默了片刻，像是在推演什么。
“运输公会不需要做什么。”
“运输队的罢工，就足以让联盟的物资运输停转。”
“到时候，黑龙军会踏平千塔。”
格里菲斯看着他，摇了摇头。
“你说得对。”
“但千塔和摩根之间的敌对，本质是大贤者想要用半魔这个种族来完成摩根对魔气的研究。”
“摩根是核心，半魔是燃料。”
“千塔的那些家族和势力，会忌讳你们运输队的身份，因为动手会给他们自己招来灭顶之灾。”
“但大贤者不会。”
“因为那个怪物，根本不在意千塔的存亡。”
他的声音更低了。
“如果牺牲千塔能让他再向那个目标前进一步，他会毫不犹豫地按下毁灭千塔的按钮。”
“凭他顶点的实力，没有人能够阻止。”
午后的阳光从头顶洒下来，将街道上的石板晒得微微发烫。
格里菲斯站在门外的台阶上，转过身，看着林鬼。
他此行来铜门城，除了给林鬼挂名之外，还带着来看看选拔会如何的想法。
如今了解过后，他就要回去了，准备招募运输队的队员。
content_en:
Griffith was silent for a moment, looked at Lin Gui, and spoke.
"Since you know the relationship between Morgan and the Great Sage, and know about Qianta's hunting of half-demon, why do you still go together with Morgan and the others?"
"When Morgan escaped with the half-demon, he completely pushed the half-demon to the opposite side of Thousand Towers."
"Your behavior of helping them become a transport team is an intolerable provocation to Qianta."
"They will see you as the enemy."
"Why are you still with the half-demon, helping them become a transport team to resist the Thousand Towers?"
Why?
It is impossible for Lin Gui to tell Griffith that he even plans to take action against the Alliance, so he still cares about Thousand Towers?
The thunder hidden in him is much more outrageous than Morgan's.
Lin Gui didn't rush to answer.
He picked up the tea cup in front of him, took a sip, put it down, and then spoke, his tone was unhurried and slow.
"So I took them to participate in the selection meeting of the transportation team and became Lieyang."
"No matter how powerful and arrogant Qian Pagoda is, it is impossible for them to attack the Lieyang Transport Team."
"Thousand Towers are the eyes of the alliance, and the Transport Guild is the heart of the alliance."
"And the blazing sun is the most important part of this heart."
He paused.
"If Qianta loses his mind and plans to attack Mr. Morgan under such circumstances——"
He was silent for a moment, as if he was deducing something.
"The Transport Guild doesn't need to do anything."
"The strike of the transportation team is enough to stop the alliance's material transportation."
"When the time comes, the Black Dragon Army will crush the Thousand Towers."
Griffith looked at him and shook his head.
"You're right."
"But the essence of the hostility between Qianta and Morgan is that the Great Sage wants to use the half-demon race to complete Morgan's research on demonic energy."
"Morgan is the core and the half-demon is the fuel."
"Those families and forces in Qianta Tower will be jealous of the identity of your transport team, because taking action will bring disaster to themselves."
"But the Great Sage will not."
"Because that monster doesn't care about the survival of Thousand Towers at all."
His voice dropped lower.
"If sacrificing the Thousand Towers can bring him one step closer to that goal, he will not hesitate to press the button to destroy the Thousand Towers."
"With his apex strength, no one can stop him."
The afternoon sun shines down from above, making the stone slabs on the street slightly hot.
Griffith stood on the steps outside the door, turned around, and looked at the Lin Kuei.
He came to Tongmen City on this trip, not only to name Lin Gui, but also to see what the selection would be like.
Now that he has learned about it, he will go back and prepare to recruit members of the transport team.
